mainAirport.name: Adelaide Airport
mainAirport.curfew: 11pm-6am (federal curfew; limited exceptions for emergency, some small jets, propeller aircraft and freight)
mainAirport.notes: Runway end coordinates from SkyVector (0.01-minute precision, ~20 m); runway 05 has a displaced threshold so the 05 touchdown point is a little north-east of the listed end. No new runway is planned; the 2019 Master Plan (approved 2020) is the current official plan. Main runway 05/23 approaches pass over the CBD/inner north-east (Thebarton, Walkerville side) and Gulf St Vincent/Glenelg North; runway 12/30 approaches pass over Plympton, Glandore, Black Forest, Unley Park towards Mitcham.

otherAirports.name: Parafield Airport
otherAirports.note: One of Australia's busiest pilot-training airports: small single- and twin-engine planes doing repeated circuits all day, over Parafield Gardens, Mawson Lakes, Salisbury and Para Hills. Not loud like jets, but very frequent; also has shorter 08/26 runways.

otherAirports.name: RAAF Base Edinburgh
otherAirports.note: Home of the P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol jets (a Boeing 737 derivative) plus other military aircraft; movements are far fewer than a civil airport but jet noise affects Elizabeth, Edinburgh, Burton and Penfield. Coordinates from SkyVector; listed ends may be thresholds rather than pavement ends (spacing is shorter than the published 2,966 m).

plans.name: North-South Corridor: River Torrens to Darlington (T2D)
plans.status: Under construction; whole project opens to traffic by 2031
plans.about: 10.5 km non-stop motorway under/along South Road: 2.2 km northern tunnels (James Congdon Drive to south of Grange Road), 2.7 km open motorway, and 4.5 km southern tunnels (just south of Anzac Highway, Glandore, to Darlington). $15.4 billion, completing the non-stop North-South Corridor from Gawler to Old Noarlunga.

plans.name: South Eastern Freeway upgrades (Glen Osmond to Mount Barker)
plans.status: Mount Barker and Verdun interchange upgrades under way; Crafers to Glen Osmond managed motorway out to tender, construction from 2027
plans.about: A program of interchange upgrades and smart-motorway works on the freeway linking Adelaide with the fast-growing Mount Barker area in the Adelaide Hills.

plans.name: Aldinga rail extension (Seaford line)
plans.status: Corridor preserved; preliminary planning done, unfunded, 'to be pursued in the 2030s'
plans.about: Would extend the electrified Seaford line south about 10 km through Seaford Rise to Aldinga, with a station at Quinliven Road and an interchange station with park 'n' ride near Aldinga Beach Road.
